events.title: Demo update 0.5.0: a training room, a new interview and five languages
events.summary: Your first days on the demo taught us one thing: the job is hard to learn under fire. So the company built a training room. This update also rebuilds the interview, calms the haunting down, and brings the game to five new languages. events.title: Demo update 0.4.0: madness, a smarter hunter, and two weeks of playtests
events.summary: The demo has changed a lot since it first went up. Two weeks of playtests, your reports and a lot of late nights later, here is everything that is new. Thank you for being here for the Next Fest. Madness You can see it coming: from half sanity, the picture darkens, loses its colours, and its edges wobble and trail, with a heartbeat that quickens as you slip.
